[RB-FIBER-CUT#03] Fiber cut on a transport link > Differential diagnosis: ... Versus a site power failure A power failure hits one site, never its siblings. It starts with `MAINS_FAILURE` hours before the site goes down and has no `LINK_LOS`. ... A degraded microwave link keeps its sites up. ... `LINK_LOS` with availability at zero is a hard failure. ... A single-site event cannot take down its siblings, and the `LINK_LOS` already explains the timing. ...
[RB-FIBER-CUT#01] Fiber cut on a transport link > Overview: A transport link (node type `transport_link`, id like `LNK-XXX-NN-A`) carries all the traffic of the sites behind it, usually three to five. ... The sites themselves are healthy. The root cause is the link, not the sites, so the report must name the link and treat the site alarms as consequences. Repairs take from about two hours to most of a working day.
[RB-ALARM-REFERENCE#02] Alarm reference > Transport alarms: `LINK_LOS` (critical, on a transport link). ... All sites behind the link go down. ... See the fiber cut and maintenance runbooks. `LINK_DEGRADED` (major or minor, on a link). A major alarm on a microwave link ("reduced modulation") means capacity loss and a service degradation. ... On a fiber link a minor alarm with falling optical power can precede a cut.
[RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#03] Microwave link degradation > Differential diagnosis: ... Versus a fiber cut ... If the link is fiber, rain fade cannot be the explanation. Versus a fiber link starting to fail On a fiber link, a minor `LINK_DEGRADED` with falling optical power can precede a cut by up to an hour. ... Versus congestion ... result.markdown:
# Transport Fiber Link Failure Causing Outage on S-TUN-008

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-TUN-02-A`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence on the fiber link precisely matches the KPI drop timing, and changes/maintenance were ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-13 00:15 to 2026-09-13 07:52
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-13 00:15
- **Affected:** S-TUN-008, S-TUN-006, S-TUN-018

## Summary

A fiber transport link failure (LINK_LOS) severed connectivity for S-TUN-008 and sibling sites, causing a complete service outage.

Customers served by S-TUN-008 experienced zero availability and no traffic from 00:15 to 07:52 on 2026-09-13.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-12 23:53: Minor LINK_DEGRADED raised on fiber link LNK-TUN-02-A. [ALM-000257]
- 2026-09-13 00:15: Critical LINK_LOS raised on LNK-TUN-02-A. [ALM-000258]
- 2026-09-13 00:16: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-TUN-008, S-TUN-006, and S-TUN-018. [ALM-000259, ALM-000260, ALM-000261]
- 2026-09-13 07:48: LINK_LOS cleared on LNK-TUN-02-A. [ALM-000258]
- 2026-09-13 07:52: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on affected sites as service restored. [ALM-000259]

## Evidence

- S-TUN-008 experienced an availability and traffic drop from 2026-09-13 00:15 to 08:00. [T1, ALR-0016]
- S-TUN-008 depends on transport link Lnk-TUN-02-A, AGG-TUN-02, and CORE-UPF-01. [T2, S-TUN-008]
- A critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on LNK-TUN-02-A at 2026-09-13 00:15. [T3, ALM-000258]
- No changes were executed on the affected nodes and ancestors between 2026-09-12 18:00 and 2026-09-13 09:01. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes and ancestors during the incident window. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-02-A: confirmed. LINK_LOS on LNK-TUN-02-A perfectly matches the timing of the simultaneous multi-site outage. [ALM-000258, RB-FIBER-CUT#01]
2. **power_failure** at S-TUN-008: rejected. A power failure only hits one site and would not take down sibling sites simultaneously with a LINK_LOS. [RB-FIBER-CUT#03]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000253: VSWR_HIGH on S-TUN-018 cleared hours before the outage and affected only one site briefly.
- ANM-000196: Core UPF throughput spike represents a network-wide metric shift unrelated to the transport link failure.
- ALR-0015: Alert concerned a different set of sites (S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003) earlier in the evening.
- ALM-000257: Minor LINK_DEGRADED preceded the fiber cut by less than an hour but did not cause the full outage by itself until the LOS occurred.

## Recommended actions

- Dispatch fiber maintenance team to inspect LNK-TUN-02-A for physical damage or degradation.
- Review optical power logs on LNK-TUN-02-A to prevent future sudden failures.
